title: Great white sharks may already be lurking off UK beaches

This finding underscores Madagascar's ongoing biological mysteries and the importance of habitat protection.

Monitoring compliance will be supported by automatic number plate recognition cameras.

Rawat's remarkable contributions in both Hindi and South Indian cinema were matched only by his genuine humility and strong on-screen presence. He leaves behind a lasting legacy.

title: 54 bank fraud accused fled India, ED seizes assets worth over Rs 35,000 crore

Unclaimed bank deposits transferred to the RBI fund total Rs 62,683.19 crore.  India's foreign exchange reserves remain comfortable, covering 10.3 months of goods imports.

title: Pakistan boxer Qudratullah ‘goes missing’ in Glasgow after CWG campaign

Pakistan finished the Commonwealth Games with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra. Her historic achievement made her the first Pakistani female boxer to win a CWG medal, while Arshad Nadeem missed out.

title: Odisha’s Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining): Eligibility, process, purpose explained

The initiative focuses on 36 blocks within nine mineral-rich districts impacted by mining. Beneficiaries will receive financial aid for construction, along with assistance for essential services like toilets. To determine eligibility, thorough surveys and checks against existing housing schemes are conducted, with registration available online or via local government officials.

The state questioned the accelerated rollout and alleged external pressure influenced the decision.  The Aam Aadmi Party is campaigning nationwide against the policy.  They demand consumer choice and lower prices for the blended fuel.

DMK workers staged protests across Tamil Nadu following the arrest. The TVK government and opposition engaged in a war of words. Udhayanidhi denied allegations and stated his remarks were distorted.

title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on UPI; what it means
description: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is the fee merchants pay to banks and payment service providers for processing digital transactions. In India, credit card payments generally attract an MDR of around 1.5%.

title: Jensen Huang on Asian parenting: 5 lessons from Nvidia CEO's childhood remarks
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang shared how his Asian parents' constant feedback shaped him.  He explained their criticism was a unique way of showing love and care.  This upbringing taught him to embrace criticism and remain humble throughout his career.  Huang now applies these lessons to his leadership style at Nvidia.  His story highlights the importance of balanced feedback in child development.

title: 'Madrassa pass-outs develop terrorist-like mindset': UP deputy CM Keshav Maurya
description: Speaking to reporters at Vidhan Bhavan, Maurya alleged that madrassa students do not express patriotic slogans and linked their education to extremism. "Anyone who receives a madrassa education does not chant 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' nor sing 'Vande Mataram', and develops a terrorist-like mindset," he was quoted as saying by news agency PTI. The remarks were strongly criticised by senior Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav.

title: 6-year-old with heart condition scores dream Panthers touchdown
description: Six-year-old Asher Harvey, who was born with a complex heart condition and has undergone multiple heart surgeries, fulfilled his dream of becoming a Carolina Panthers player for a day through Make-A-Wish. He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

title: Drone hunters: How helicopters are becoming the battlefield's new predator
description: Modern battlefields face a significant drone proliferation challenge globally.  Affordable weapons and guided rockets are being adapted for drone interception.  Helicopters are emerging as ideal platforms for effective counter-drone operations.  India is developing indigenous solutions for drone warfare capabilities.  These adaptations aim to address the economic disparity in modern air combat.

title: ‘Respectful language should still be maintained’: Ex-India captain on abuse against PM Modi
description: Former India football captain Bhaichung Bhutia said citizens have the right to protest but should avoid abusive language, especially against the Prime Minister. Manu Bhaker also urged youngsters to use respectful words. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, meanwhile, said he did not want the protesters punished, calling their actions mistakes and hoping they would learn from them.

title: 'Private media entity organising it': Govt says 'no role' in Hasina's Aug 5 event
description: The MEA stated no government involvement in a private media event.  The proposed forum concerns former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.  Bangladesh sought clarification from India regarding its support for the event.  Hasina resigned in August 2024 and has been living in Delhi.  She faces a death sentence for crimes against humanity.

title: 'A rebirth for us': Passengers recall chaos after Air India flight hits turbulence
description: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi encountered severe turbulence on Tuesday morning. The aircraft briefly lost altitude, causing injuries to 17 passengers and crew members. One cabin crew member sustained severe injuries, while others had minor wounds. Passengers described the terrifying ordeal, with some being thrown from their seats. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has launched a thorough investigation into the incident.

title: 'Who is PM Modi to forgive?' Rahul says students 'need apology not forgiveness'
description: In an Instagram video posted on Friday night PM said that he will forgive young protesters accused of abusing him and his late mother, saying they are misguided children and it is “our job to show them the right way” “Nothing is more painful than seeing a parent grieve their child. Behind every young life lost is a family carrying pain that will never leave them - and serious questions about a broken education system,” Gandhi said in a post on X where he also shared images of his interaction with parents and students.

title: '2k samples tested': Govt dismisses fuel adulteration claims, says only 2 cases found
description: The Ministry of Petroleum has rolled out enhanced fuel quality measures, implementing water ingress testing that occurs multiple times a day at various fuel stations. In a comprehensive assessment, more than two thousand samples were analyzed for contaminants, revealing minimal problems. Sales were promptly halted at locations with verified contamination. The Ministry warns that stringent penalties will be enforced against any future instances of adulteration.

title: 'Never got the credit he deserved': Gavaskar compares Rahane to Dravid
description: Sunil Gavaskar lauded Ajinkya Rahane's leadership during India's historic Australia tour victory. Rahane captained the team through significant challenges and injuries to secure a remarkable series win. Gavaskar noted Rahane's exceptional captaincy record, which often went unappreciated by the public. He highlighted Rahane's crucial century after a devastating defeat, inspiring a comeback. Rahane departs cricket with immense respect from all involved in the sport.

title: Spices coated in cloth dye, talcum powder? Hyderabad raids expose food adulteration
description: Over 25,000 kg of hazardous chemical-laced spices were seized during raids. Three people were arrested after inspections uncovered alarming non-compliance with food safety laws. Dangerous practices involved synthetic chemicals, cloth dyes, and shining powder in spices. Strict legal proceedings are initiated against violating business owners under the Food Safety Act. Enforcement drives will continue to ensure safe, unadulterated food products reach consumers.

title: 'Will do whatever is necessary': India after Pak deploys 250 Chinese Howitzers
description: India stated it will protect national interests after Pakistan deployed Chinese artillery guns.  Pakistan has reportedly deployed around 250 Chinese-made SH-15 artillery systems.  India criticized Pakistan's recent elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as a farce.  The spokesperson noted civilian deaths during a crackdown in the region.  Both nations continue to modernize their respective artillery capabilities.

title: Vedika Pinto recalls Anurag Kashyap's advice that led her to 'Musafir Cafe'
description: Musafir Cafe breakout star Vedika Pinto tells mid-day how her Nishaanchi director Anurag Kashyap encouraged her to take on the Netflix series, why the show has given her something Nishaanchi couldn't, and what it was like working with National Award winner Vikrant Massey.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: US may raise H-1B, L-1 visa fees for large employers under DHS proposal
description: The US government plans to expand an additional visa fee. This fee currently applies to certain large employers filing H-1B and L-1 petitions. The planned change will extend this charge to visa extension requests. Qualifying employers with over fifty employees and a majority in H-1B or L-1 status will be affected. This expansion aims to fund biometric entry-exit system improvements and other government programs.

title: Student housing is India's next real estate hotspot, says report - here's why
description: The surge in India's higher education landscape is driving a notable increase in demand for student accommodation. With international universities thriving and overseas education expenses rising, a remarkable demographic shift is anticipated, projecting over 70 million students by 2035. This educational migration will generate massive housing needs, prompting a significant boost in institutional investments aimed at nationwide accommodation development.

title: 'It's my fault': Stokes blames himself for McCullum's England Test coach exit
description: Former England captain Ben Stokes desires to coach the national team in the future. He is currently pursuing his Level Three coaching qualification while still playing. Stokes confirmed his international playing career has concluded, dismissing Ashes return speculation. He expressed surprise at Joe Root's appointment as Test captain over Harry Brook. Stokes praised Stephen Fleming as the new Test coach and wished Root success.

title: Rs 15.56 crore: The money behind the medal at 2026 CWG
description: India's 39-medal Commonwealth Games campaign highlighted the impact of the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), which funds elite athletes through customised training, competition exposure and sports science support. This TimesofIndia.com explainer details how athletes are selected, funded and reviewed, while outlining the government's enhanced investment in high-performance sport as India builds towards the 2036 Games ambitions.

title: From apps to 'intent': How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑gen phones
description: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
description: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance for marine health. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vast Pacific waters and their ecosystems.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey from poverty to football greatness
description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.
